title: Mobile phone with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- phone body -->
  <rect x="28" y="8" width="44" height="84" rx="8" ry="8" fill="#4FC3F7"/>
  <!-- body edge highlight -->
  <rect x="31" y="11" width="38" height="78" rx="6" ry="6" fill="#29B6F6"/>
  <!-- screen -->
  <rect x="34" y="20" width="32" height="52" rx="3" ry="3" fill="#1A237E"/>
  <!-- screen glow -->
  <rect x="36" y="22" width="28" height="48" rx="2" ry="2" fill="#283593"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="44" cy="40" r="4" fill="#00E5FF"/>
  <circle cx="56" cy="40" r="4" fill="#00E5FF"/>
  <!-- eye shine -->
  <circle cx="45.5" cy="38.5" r="1.5" fill="#B2EBF2"/>
  <circle cx="57.5" cy="38.5" r="1.5" fill="#B2EBF2"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M42 50 Q50 60 58 50" stroke="#00E5FF" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx="39" cy="48" r="2.5" fill="#FF80AB"/>
  <circle cx="61" cy="48" r="2.5" fill="#FF80AB"/>
  <!-- home button -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="82" r="4" fill="#B3E5FC"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="82" r="2.5" fill="#81D4FA"/>
  <!-- speaker slot -->
  <rect x="44" y="14" width="12" height="2" rx="1" fill="#B3E5FC"/>
  <!-- side button -->
  <rect x="71" y="30" width="2" height="8" rx="1" fill="#039BE5"/>
  <!-- volume buttons -->
  <rect x="27" y="28" width="2" height="6" rx="1" fill="#039BE5"/>
  <rect x="27" y="38" width="2" height="6" rx="1" fill="#039BE5"/>
</svg>
